title: マーケティング戦略
subtitle: Marketing Strategy
educationalGoal: This course is the course for developing "Marketing Ability (K)". Through the lectures, learn the concepts, theories and methods of marketing activities necessary for business management Identify their role and effectiveness through information gathering and case analysis. We also aim to create an image for co-creation with society, such as education and CDIO practice.
advice:
Course description
○ Lectures on various marketing themes are held. This course focuses on the basic concepts of marketing and the relationship between strategies, suc as ① Marketing research, ② 4P (product, price, place, promotion), ③ Brand formation.
○ In class, use PowerPoint and whiteboard together. List important keywords and points and discuss them with
Deepen understanding of the theory. In addition, we will try to learn effectively by incorporating video and online information.

Expectations
○ Ask for your own ideas, not memorization of knowledge.
○ Always keep an eye on the latest markets and make your own thoughts and interpretations of the movement.
○ It is very important to actively participate in classes every time. Absence, lateness, and poor attitude are strictly prohibited.
requiredKnowledge: ◎ Specialized education and training objectives of the Department of Management Systems, aiming to develop "IT skills", "Marketing skills", "Financial & accounting skills", "Management Skills", "Logical Thinking", "Database Management skills". ◎ It is desirable to always pay attention to market trends and collect the latest market information. ◎ Preparation is basically unnecessary, but review is required.

activityGoals.body: Understand the purpose and requirements of marketing and explain the importance of marketing activities.
Explain important marketing concepts in plain language.
Explain the common points and differences of marketing methods of each product in an assumed product market.
Understand and explain the need for branding in companies.
Be able to constantly monitor trends in a specific market and summarize and explain market trends.
From a marketing perspective, it is possible to formulate strategies for solving various management issues.
